title: Go! Go! Loser Ranger! Manga Goes on Hiatus Again Due to Creator's Health
content:
This year's 47th issue of Kodansha 's Weekly Shōnen Magazine announced on Wednesday that Negi Haruba 's Go, Go, Loser Ranger! ( Sentai Daishikkaku ) manga is going on hiatus due to Haruba's health. The announcement did not reveal when the manga will resume.

The series previously entered a hiatus on July 8, and only recently returned last month on September 24.

The manga entered its final arc on March 18 earlier this year, when it returned from a month-long hiatus.

Kodansha USA Publishing is releasing the manga in English, and it describes the series:

When the Monster Army invaded Earth thirteen years ago, the Divine Dragon Rangers rose up to stop them! With the war raging on, these great heroes are mankind's last hope! ...or are they? In truth, the invaders were subjugated within a year, forced to continue to crank out a monster a week for the Rangers to crush in front of their adoring fans! But one monster has had enough. Something has to change! He'll rebel against the might of the Dragon Rangers and destroy them all...from the inside!

Haruba ( The Quintessential Quintuplets ) launched the ongoing manga in Weekly Shōnen Magazine in February 2021.

The manga inspired a television anime . The first season premiered on the TBS channel and 27 of its affiliates in April 2024. The anime is available worldwide on Disney+ (and on Hulu in North America). The second season premiered in April 2025. Disney+ again streamed the anime.
author: ANN

title: Eleceed TV Anime's English-Subtitled Trailer Reveals April 2027 Delay
content:
The official website for the television anime of author Jeho Son and artist ZHENA 's webtoon series ELECEED started streaming the anime's English-subtitled trailer, and announced its April 2027 premiere on Wednesday.

Amuse Creative Studio had originally announced a 2026 premiere for the anime.

The anime's YouTube channel describes the story:

Hidden in the shadows of the modern world, there exist associations and organizations of people known as the “Awakened” — those who possess superhuman abilities. High schooler Jiwoo Seo knows nothing of this world, living in fear while hiding his own mysterious power. Then one day, after he nurses an injured stray cat back to health, Jiwoo's world is turned upside down. "Let go of me already, you fool!!" The battered stray cat — which should never have been able to talk — suddenly speaks?! The stray cat turns out to be Kayden, the strongest of the Awakened, transformed by mysterious means. Unable to return to his human form, Kayden begins living with Jiwoo... Jiwoo, who never felt he could become anything, and Kayden, the solitary, unrivaled Awakened,are soon drawn into the organizations and conspiracies of the Awakened world. Led by a cat. Bound for greatness. Can the two of them change the world—?

The anime will star:

• Junya Enoki as Jiwoo Seo (listed as Yuu Kazahaya in the above promo video), a reeserved young man who avoids involvement with others

• Tasuku Hatanaka as Wooin (listed as Jin Tatsuoka in the above promo video), a mysterious Awakened who transfers into Jiwoo's class

• Setsuji Satō as Dr. Delein, a brilliant scientist consumed by his relentless pursuit of research

• Hayato Dojima as Jisuk Yoo (listed as Sota Yanagi in the above promo video), a hot-headed Awakened student who attends the same school as Jiwoo

• Shizuka Itō as Jiyoung Yoo (listed as Amane Yanagi in the above promo video), "the young leader of 'Mythos,' one of the largest Awakened organizations in Japan."

Hiroshi Nishikiori ( IDOLiSH7 the Movie LIVE 4bit BEYOND THE PERiOD , Honey Lemon Soda ) is directing the anime at DandeLion Animation Studio ( The First Slam Dunk ). Yousuke Kuroda ( My Hero Academia ) is writing and overseeing the series scripts. Minami Sakura ( Gridman Universe ) is the character designer.

Additional staff members include:

• Sub-Character Design: Masato Katō, Mina Ōsawa, Kōji Watanabe

• Assistant Director: Miyuki Wakai

• Chief Animation Supervisors: Minami Sakura, Masato Katō

• Art Director: Mayu Imaichi

• Color Design: Haruko Nobori

• Director of Photography: Yūjirō Yamane

• Special Effects: Miyako Hoshi

• CG Supervisor: Takeshi Shimizu

• Editor: Shigeru Nishiyama

• Sound Director: Takatoshi Hamano

• Music: Taku Iwasaki

Since its debut in 2018, ELECEED has been serialized in over 10 languages, including English, Korean, Japanese, Chinese, French, and Spanish. It remains a consistent top performer on NAVER WEBTOON's battle-action charts in North America, Asia, and Europe. The series has surpassed 1.7 billion views globally.

Son's Noblesse received a television anime adaptation by Production I.G in 2020. A previous 30-minute Noblesse: Awakening OAV released in 2016. Crunchyroll streams both anime.

title: Grotesqqque Anime Film Previews Song by Junna, yutori's Kotoko Satō
content:
The official website for Atsushi Nishigori 's original anime film Grotesqqque (previously titled Grotesque) confirmed on Wednesday that the film will feature the song "ZUKIZUKI" as performed by JUNNA and the yutori rock band's vocalist Kotoko Satō , two music contributors for the "Yoroshiku★Girl" short story. Yuyoyuppe , another music contributor for "Yoroshiku★Girl," wrote the lyrics as well as scored and arranged the music. The song is now available on various music services, and the website also started streaming the song's collaboration music video with the film:

The film is an omnibus film of three stories with different worldviews.

• "A(E)liens"

• "Yoroshiku★Girl," (also known as "4649 Girl," pronounced as "Yoroshiku★Shōjo," a pun on the words "Nice to Meet You★Girl" with the literal meaning of the kanji being "Evening Dew Heads to Its Death★Girl." The numbers 4649 can be read in Japanese as "Yoroshiku.")

• "Nocturne: Nuit Grotesque" ("Nocturne: Kono Grotesque na Yoru ni," literally, Nocturne: On This Grotesque Night, romanized in a previous video as "Nocturn: En Cette Nuit Grotesque.")

The film's cast members and characters include :

For the "A(E)liens" story:

• Kana Ichinose as Ellie

• Gen Hoshino as Kento Kurikura

• Akio Ōtsuka as Space Agency Bureau Director

For the "Yoroshiku★Girl" story:

• Sara Minami as Stella

• Ikumi Hasegawa as Unknown (Nanashi)

• Saori Hayami as Hikarin

• Maaya Uchida as Gorgeous Mika

• Chika Anzai as Sword

• Miyu Tomita as Chiffon

• Rumi Ōkubo as Papico

• Rie Kugimiya as Poyomi

For the "Nocturne: Nuit Grotesque" story:

• Nagi Inoue (from Nogizaka46) as Ayame

• Aruno Nakanishi (from Nogizaka46) as Shion

• Miku Ichinose (from Nogizaka46) as Momo

• Nao Tomisato (from Nogizaka46) as Canna

The 35 musical acts contributing to each story in the film are:

"A(E)liens:"

• Mika Ichinose

• VaVa

• Ken Kamikita

• sabio/Fūta Takamura

• SEE

• Surii

• Taku Inoue

• tsumiki

• Yūshi Nakajima (from Gusokumuzu)

• Nanahira

• Hashimero

"Yoroshiku★Girl"

• ASCA

• Akki

• -otoha-

• Kotoko Satō (from yutori)

• Kanon Shizaki

• Ayato Shinozaki

• JUNNA

• Suisō

• Ryōsuke Tachibana

• Shiina Natsukawa

• Iori Noguchi (from =LOVE)

• Shōta Horie (also known as kemu)

• Myuk

• MIRI

• Rei Yasuda

• Yuyoyuppe

• Runaar

• Reol

"Nocturne: Nuit Grotesque"

• eba

• Nakano+

• Kairi Yagi

Atsushi Nishigori ( The IDOLM@STER , DARLING in the FRANXX ) is directing the film, and is also writing the screenplay and designing the characters.

The band METALVERSE performs the opening theme song "Shoot Shoot Shoot." Haoto performs the ending theme song with lyrics by momosu momosu.

The film comes from JOEN , the company jointly established by Sony media subsidiary Aniplex , its CloverWorks animation studio, Production I.G sister company Wit Studio , and publisher Shueisha . CloverWorks producer Yūichi Fukushima and Wit Studio producer Tetsuya Nakatake are the representative directors of JOEN .

The film will open in Japan on November 6. The film's "Yoroshiku★Girl" segment will stream early for a limited time on Netflix in Japan from October 23 to November 5.

The film had its world premiere at this year's Fantasia International Film Festival , which took place in Montreal from July 16-August 2. The Japan Society host the U.S. premiere of the film in collaboration with CloverWorks and Aniplex of America in New York City on October 8. Director Nishigori gave a pre-screening introduction in-person at the event.

title: AFA Singapore Adds Voice Actress Satomi Arai for Re:ZERO Panel
content:
Kadokawa announced on Monday that Satomi Arai will attend the AFA Singapore convention as part of a panel for the Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- anime . The panel will take place at the convention on November 28.

Arai voices the character Beatrice in the anime.

The fourth season of the anime consisted of 19 episodes divided into two arcs. The season debuted with "The Loss Arc" on April 8. Then, "The Recapture Arc" began on August 12.

Masahiro Shinohara directed the fourth season at WHITE FOX . Masahiro Yokotani was in charge of series composition. Haruka Sagawa was the character designer and chief animation director.

The AFA Singapore convention will take place at the Suntec Singapore International Convention and Exhibition Centre in Singapore on November 27 to 29.

title: Anime Limited Will Release Collector's 4K UHD Blu-ray of Angel's Egg on November 2
content:
The on-disc extras in the Collector's Edition will include an Interview with Yoshitaka Amano , and another interview with Mamoru Oshii and Yoshitaka Amano . The release will also include four art cards and a 24-page booklet containing an essay by Danielle Burgos,

Anime Limited describes the title:

"In an underwater city, a young girl takes care of a large egg she holds carefully in her arms. A boy with a gun arrives in search of a bird he saw in his dream. At first, it seems as if feelings of sympathy are developing between the two.

"Forty years after the film's original release, GKIDS is proud to present an all-new 4K restoration of the film, supervised by director Mamoru Oshii .

"The film is a creative collaboration between acclaimed director Mamoru Oshii ( Ghost in the Shell ), who wrote and directed the feature, and revered artist Yoshitaka Amano (Final Fantasy, Vampire Hunter D ). The film beautifully intertwines Oshii's thematic reflections on philosophy and theology with Amano's distinctive ink painting style, culminating in an arrestingly beautiful hand-drawn allegorical fantasy."

Tokuma Shoten announced the Angel's Egg remaster in May 2024. The remaster is based on a new scan of a 35mm film negative of the anime.

The Angel's Egg original video anime ( OVA ) debuted in Japan in 1985. Oshii directed the OVA at Studio DEEN . Oshii and Yoshitaka Amano conceived the story, and Oshii wrote the screenplay and directed. Amano also handled the art direction. Hiroshi Hasegawa , Masao Kobayashi , Mitsunori Miura , and Yutaka Wada produced the film. Yoshihiro Kanno composed the music.

Carl Colpaert 's live-action/animated 1987 film In the Aftermath spliced footage from the film.

title: Animate Manila Store to Open Animate Cafe in 2027
content:
Animate's new directly-owned store in Manila opened on Friday, and also revealed that it will use the space adjacent to it to open an Animate Cafe sometime in 2027.

Aside from offering food and drinks, Animate often uses its Animate Cafe branches to host collaboration cafes for various franchises.

Animate's Manila store is located at the One Ayala mall in Makati, Metro Manila.

Before the Manila store, Animate's most recently-opened store outside of Japan is its Hong Kong store, which opened in December 2025.

Animate has opened a number of pop-up stores in locations outside of Japan, as well as four permanent stores in China (five including the most recent Hong Kong store), three in Taiwan, two in Thailand, one in South Korea, and one in California, USA. A pop-up store in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia reopened as a permanent store in October 2025.

title: Singer May'n Performs in Bengaluru at Japan Habba 2027
content:
Japan Habba will take place on January 9 and January 10 at Chamara Vajra Palace Grounds, Bengaluru.

May'n performed songs as the Macross Frontier anime's "Galactic Fairy" idol Sheryl Nome. Beyond her performances for Macross Frontier , May'n has performed theme songs for anime series including The Ancient Magus' Bride , Accel World , Phi-Brain - Puzzle of God , Aria the Scarlet Ammo , Inari Kon Kon , Taboo Tattoo , Lord of Vermilion: The Crimson King , Izetta: The Last Witch , Phantom in the Twilight , and M3 - Sono Kuroki Hagane . She performed the opening theme song for the television anime series Aquarion Logos with composer Yōko Kanno . She reprised her role as the singing voice of Sheryl Nome with the new song "Gooorgeous," and collaborated with the Wake Up, Girls! group to perform the opening theme song for the Restaurant to Another World anime.

Nakamura voiced the character Urushi Yaotome in When Will Ayumu Make His Move? , Alicia Williams in I’ll Become a Villainess Who Goes Down in History , Anghalad in The Seven Deadly Sins: Four Knights of the Apocalypse , and Narita Top Road in Uma Musume Pretty Derby: Road to the Top .

The event will host Love Live! Sunshine!! voice actress Kanako Takatsuki as a guest at the event. It will host musician Lotus Juice and the artist's performance will be on January 10 at 6:00 p.m. IST. Asaka , Kanapon, and Nanometer will also perform at the event.

The staff describes the event:

Since its inception in 2005, Japan Habba has been at the forefront of promoting Indo-Japanese cultural exchange. The event serves as a platform for enthusiasts to experience the essence of Japan and connect with like-minded individuals.

The Japan Habba 2025 event took place on January 12 and hosted controversial mascot character Chiitan, a Hello Kitty mascot, idol group Nanometer, musical ensemble Ryoma Quartet, and musician Kanapon. The event also included anime screenings, a manga workshop, "Light Novel Title Mad Libs," a karaoke competition, yukata wearing activity, a Japanese cinema seminar, as well as several Japanese food stalls. The cosplay events included a cosplay showcase, a " cosplay chess" event, and a dedicated gaming tournament for cosplayers .

The 2023 event hosted a Tech & Jobs Fair on May 13 and a Cultural Festival on May 14 at the National Science Seminar Complex and Satish Dhawan Auditorium, Indian Institute of Science, Bengaluru. It hosted a seminar titled "The Greatest Artistic Movement in Anime," which spoke of the moe movement and drew on the works of Patrick Galbraith and Eiji Ootsuka. The Animathon quiz had over 200 participants and team "Cardcaptor Sakuga" won the grand prize. Finalists in the quiz won Bocchi the Rock! keychains. The Cultural Festival also had a cosplay showcase, Pokémon Go event, and Smash Bros Ultimate tournament. Tomokuni Terukina, "a sanshin master of the Afuso-ryu school," performed on stage on May 14. The event featured stalls selling anime and manga merchandise as well as activities involving tea ceremony, calligraphy, ikebana, and origami, and traditional Japanese food.

title: Just Like Mona Lisa TV Anime's 1st Trailer Unveils More Cast & Staff, 2027 Debut
content:
The official website for the television anime of Tsumuji Yoshimura 's Just Like Mona Lisa (Seibetsu "Mona Lisa" no Kimi e.) manga presented on Wednesday the anime's first main trailer, main visual, additional cast and staff members, and 2027 premiere. The video announces and previews the ending theme song "Mayoi wa Hikari" (The Illusion Is Light) by singer-songwriter imase .

The newly announced cast members are Yoshino Aoyama , Nobuhiko Okamoto , Snow Man group member Daisuke Sakuma , Chiharu , Kakeru Hatano , Haruna Mikawa , and Shion Wakayama .

The anime's staff also revealed the character visuals for protagonist Hinase and their childhood friends and classmates. but did not announce which character the new cast members will voice:

Chika Anzai as Hinase Arima, a third-year high school student who remains genderless among their peers as they turn 18. They are childhood friends with Shiori and Ritsu.

Shiori Takayama, a third-year high school student who has a serious personality and loves drawing. He has feelings for his childhood friend Hinase.

Ritsu Kaga, an energetic and cheerful third-year high school student and a member of the tennis club. She has feelings for her her childhood friend HInase.

Aoi Shirogane, a third-year high school student who struggles due to her tall height. She has been friends with Chiaki Kurokawa since kindergarten.

Chiaki Kurokawa, a third-year high school student and Aoi's childhood friend since kindergarten. He's a bit of a jester but has a straightforward personality, and often tends to exaggerate his height.

Tamaki Beppu, a third-year high school student who has a straightforward and honest personality, and is like a big sister to everyone.

Rui Kinosaki, a third-year high school student with a considerate personality and a talent with handicrafts.

Mahiro Goshiki, a third-year high school student with a gentle and easygoing personality and a passion for making sweets.

The newly announced staff members are:

• Series Script Supervisor: Katsuhiko Takayama

• Assistant Director: Kōji Matsumura

• Chief Animation Directors: Kazuya Shiotsuki, Akihisa Takano

title: 'Haru to Gen ~70-sai, Hajimete Kosodate~' Short Anime's Teaser Reveals Cast, January 4 Debut
content:
The official website for the short-format television anime of Yuka Ōshima 's Haru to Gen ~70-sai, Hajimete Kosodate~ (Haru and Gen: Raising a Child for the First Time at 70) manga unveiled a new teaser promotional video for the anime on Wednesday. The teaser reveals the anime's cast, as well as its January 4 premiere.

The cast includes:

• Bin Shimada as Gen, a divorced 70 year old man living alone

• Hiromi Igarashi as Haru, Gen's granddaughter

• Mayuko Kazama as Sakura, Gen's only daughter, who died from an illness

The anime will premiere on the TV Kanagawa (tvk) channel on January 4 at 9:55 p.m. (7:55 a.m. EST).

The manga's story centers on Gen, a 70-year-old man who was estranged by his wife and daughter after a divorce many years ago. After his daughter's death, he has been entrusted to take care of his three-year-old granddaughter Haru. Having neglected his family in the past, Gen now faces the challenge of raising a child for the first time, along with its unexpected twists and turns.

Kōdai Satō ( Tom to Jerry Gokko ) is directing the anime at IMAGICA Infos and Imageworks Studio in collaboration with Studio Nanahoshi . Taeko Miura ( Kanagawa Elves , Hyakki Yakou Shou ) is directing the sound, Maki Takuma ( After-School Hanako-kun , Love Live! Nijigasaki High School Idol Club ) is in charge of sound effects, and bermei.inazawa ( Potion, Waga Mi o Tasukeru , Marukano ) is composing the music. RD is in charge of sound production, and Kazuya Takahashi ( Love and Lies , Saiyuki Reload Blast ) is the executive producer.

Ōshima launched the manga on Kadokawa 's TATESC Comic vertical-scrolling, full-color webcomic label in December 2022. Kadokawa published the manga's first compiled book volume in March 2024.

title: Just Like Mona Lisa Anime Reveals Main Visual, Trailer, Additional Cast, Ending Theme Song Artist
content:
Just Like Mona Lisa anime revealed a main visual along with a teaser trailer featuring the ending theme song and seven additional cast members. Japanese singer imase is performing the ending theme song, which is featured in the latest trailer. Studio SHAFT is animating the series, set to premiere in 2027.

The voice cast includes:

• Chika Anzai as Hinase Arima

• Yoshino Aoyama

• Nobuhiko Okamoto

• Daisuke Sakuma

• Chiharu

• Kakeru Hatano

• Haruna Mikawa

• Shion Wakayama

The main staff includes:

• Original work: Jun Yoshimura (The Gender of Mona Lisa’s You)

• Director: Kana Shundo

• Character Design / Chief Animation Director: Nobuhiro Sugiyama

• Music: Yuki Hayashi

• Animation Production: SHAFT

• Production: CyberAgent

First announced by CyberAgent under the codename “Project M,” the adaptation will bring Yoshimura’s acclaimed romance drama to the screen through the studio behind Puella Magi Madoka Magica , the Monogatari series, and March Comes in Like a Lion . The production also coincides with SHAFT’s 50th anniversary year.

We also had the opportunity to talk with Just Like Mona Lisa manga author Tsumuji Yoshimura, Studio SHAFT’s CEO Mitsutoshi Kubota, and CyberAgent producer Manami Kabashima during their visit to the German convention AnimagiC. Set in a world where people are born genderless and typically choose a gender around the age of twelve, the story follows high school student Hinase Arima, who remains genderless at eighteen. Hinase’s quiet life begins to change when childhood friends Ritsu Kaga and Shiori Takayama both confess their feelings. Source: Official Website , X (formerly Twitter) ©Tsumuji Yoshimura/SQUARE ENIX, Just Like Mona Lisa Partners
